_comment: Curated data for tools/check-alignment-register-on-pr.py (delta gate D15). 'aliases' maps a name the corpus cites to the Standard ID of the register row that tracks it; 'umbrella' maps a family or part citation (a regular expression matched against the whole citation, case-insensitive) to the register row that covers the family (an optional 'also' lists further Standard IDs a combined citation names, and the umbrella applies only when all of them are present); 'not_citable' lists generic placeholders, column labels and bare publisher names that are not citations; 'agency_labels' lists agencies whose name is reported as a citation (bare, or with the text after a colon when that text is not registered), because a table row naming one points at its instruments, where a publisher label before a colon only heads descriptive text. An alias or umbrella whose row is absent from the register is ignored, so removing a row can never leave a citation silently registered. Add an alias when a register row exists under another name; add a row to the register, not an alias, when none does. Keep the 'aliases' keys in case-insensitive order (a test checks it).
